result.summary: The image depicts a wide residential street with row houses and a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the broad roadway width and long crossing distances at the intersection may encourage higher vehicle speeds and increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Wide roadway width
hazards.description: The excessive width of the travel lanes and overall roadway can lead to higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The distance across the intersection is significant, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic without a refuge.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder style markings for better visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to manage vehicle speeds along the residential block.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection with marked crosswalks and a concrete pedestrian refuge island. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the significant crossing distance and wide roadway geometry prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with vehicle traffic signals but a complete absence of pedestrian-specific infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals. The existing sidewalk is in fair to poor condition with visible cracking and uneven surfaces, and sightlines are partially obstructed by overgrown vegetation.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross an undefined path in a signalized environment.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk slabs are cracked and misaligned, creating potential trip hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the left side of the image may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder-style pavement markings to clearly define the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the intersection corners for accessibility.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim overgrown bushes and trees to restore clear sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.
